Experience the magic this Thursday, November 16, 2023, as VSRF LIVE proudly presents an exclusive evening with our cherished artists, Five Times August and Joseph Arthur. Get ready for an unforgettable night filled with soul-stirring melodies, intimate conversations, and a deep dive into their musical odyssey during the challenging times of Covid lockdowns, mandates, censorship, and cancellation.
Step into the world of Five Times August, where singer-songwriter Brad Skistimas shares his unique perspective on the journey through the pandemic, exploring the highs and lows of creating music in the face of adversity. Joseph Arthur, a seasoned musician known for his eclectic style and profound lyricism, will join the conversation, offering insights into his artistic process and how he navigated the twists and turns of the music industry amid unprecedented challenges.
This exclusive edition of VSRF LIVE goes beyond the ordinary. Our artists will share their experiences of defying corporate music cancellations, offering a glimpse into the resilience that fuels their creative spirits. Join us for a captivating dialogue that transcends the music itself, providing a rare opportunity to connect with these exceptional talents on a personal level.
Don’t miss your chance to be part of this epic edition of VSRF LIVE, where the power of music and conversation converge. Tune in on Thursday for a night that promises to be both inspirational and entertaining, as we celebrate the triumph of artistic expression against all odds. VSRF LIVE: Your gateway to unforgettable moments, unfiltered discussions, and a celebration of resilience in the face of adversity. Show less
